473)sngon 'gro bsags sbyong byed tshul mdor bsdus snying por dril ba bzhugs/na mo gu ra we/'dir rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zab gter las byon

tei:div.tei:p: 473) sngon 'gro bsags sbyong byed tshul mdor bsdus snying por dril ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ra we/ 'dir rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zab gter las byon pa'i rdzogs pa chen po sangs rgyas lag 'chang gi sngon 'gro'i bsags sbyong byed tshul mdor bsdus bri ba la/ srid pa khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la snying thag pa nas skyo shas skye zhing*/ thar 'dod kyi nges 'byung bcos ma min pa rgyud la 'khrungs nas/ tshe 'di'i bya bzhag blos ling gis gtong nus pa'i gang zag gis lam zab 'di la 'jug par bya ste/ phyi nang rgyu 'grul dben zhing*/ rig pa ngang gis dwangs la/ nyams dga' ba'i gnas su thun dang thun mtshams phye nas nyams su blang dgos/ de'ang tho rangs bya grags snga phyi bar gsum gang rung nas tsha ja bar thor thun/ nyi ma dros nas nyin phyed bar snga thun/ grib ma gug tsam nas nyi thal bar phyi thun/ srod gdong nag nas srod yol bar dgong thun nam srod thun te bzhir nges par byas la/ tho rangs gnyid nam sad pa'i dus/ mal nas har gyis ldang*/ thun 'di ma grol gyi bar du bya ba gal chen ci la thug kyang*/ lus mi 'gul/ ngag mi smra/ yid mi g.yo ba rnams su dam bca'/ 474) lus gnad bsam gtan gyi 'bol chung la rnam snang gi chos bdun bca'/ ngag gnad rlung ro dgu phrugs bsal la tshe rabs thog med kyi sdig sgrib dang*/ thun 'di'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar chad bying rgod kyi sgrib pa thams cad sangs kyis dag par bsam/ yid gnad kun slong la brtag dge mi dge'i rtog pa tshe 'di'i 'jigs legs la bsam na spang*/ lung ma bstan ci dran 'di dran med pa bcos/ dge ba'i rtog pa skyes bu chung ngus ngan song la 'jigs nas mtho ris thob 'dod yod kyang lam zhugs kyi bsam pa des mi yong*/ skyes bu 'bring gis 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal du shes nas rang nyid myang 'das thob 'dod tsam yod kyang theg dman du 'gro/

skyes bu chen pos sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gaud 'dod kyis smon 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems yang dag par bskyed/ lus ngag yid gsum cha snyoms kyi gnad du bla ma la gsol ba gdab dgos te/ bla ma mkhyen/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas rang gi snying dbus padma ge sar gyi steng nas tshangs bug gi lam brgyud rtsa ba'i bla ma yar 'od phung ye re re byon ste/ spyi gtsug khru gang tsam gyi pad sdong gi khar dgyes bzhin bzhugs par bsam la/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ 475) /bdag gi spyi bor padma'i gdan bzhugs la// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de la snying khung rus pa'i gting nas dad pa mchi ma ma 'khrugs bar bskyed de gsol ba gdab pas/ kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab shrī seng= sogs dang*/ 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis= sogs dang*/ mkha' khyab zhing nas phrin las mi zad= sogs/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dpal ldan bla ma rin po che mkhyen no/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol= sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pas/ bla ma yang 'od phung gi rnam pas rang la thim pas thugs yid dbyer med du 'dres pa'i ngang la dal gcig mi dmigs par gzhag rnam rtog gcig ldang ba dang mnyam du/ rtsa tshig dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu rnyed par dka': sogs/ sdug bsngal yod: bar dal bar lan gcig bton nas/ tshig gi nus pas don dran dgos pas las dang po pas tshig cung zad rgyas na legs pas klong chen snying tig gi sngon 'gro'i 476) ngag 'don dang sbrel na kha chos su ma song ba re nges par 'ong 'dug na yang rang rang mos pa bstun/ de nas ngo bo dal ba brgyad/ khyad par gyi chos 'byor pa bcu po rang rgyud la tshang min brtag la/

dal 'byor chos so bzhi po ldan pa rgyu dpe grangs gsum gyis rnyed pa dka' ba u dum wa ra/ rnyed pa don ldan yid bzhin nor bu 'di'ang*/ nges par 'chi ba/ nam 'chi nges pa med pa/ 'chi ba'i tshe gang gis kyang mi phan/ shi nas med du mi 'gro/ 'gro zhing skye ba len dgos/ skye ba gang du len na/ 'gro ba rigs drug las ma 'das pas/ rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal la bsam gzhig zhib par btang ste rang rgyud chos dang 'dres nges par bya/ thun mthar/ dge ba ma rgan 'gro drug kun la bsngo: zhes dang*/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo= sogs bsngo smon ci rigs brjod de dge rtsa gzhan don du bsngo/ de nas thun nang gi rtog pa la brtag ste/ dge ba kho na byung na dga' ba sgoms/ thun gzhan rnams la de las lhag tsam bya ba dam bca'/ mi dge ba'i rtogs pa byung na nyes pa bshags/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bya bar dam bcas nas/ thun mtshams spyod lam la 'jug go de ltar gyis dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag las 477)rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ thar pa'i phan yon/ bshes gnyen bsten tshul rnams la re re bzhin zhag bdun re las mi nyung bar blo sbyong zin nas/ thun gyi sngon 'gro rnams mdor bsdus tsam blo sbyong byas nas skyabs 'gror bab tshe/ mdun gyi nam mkhar= sogs/ skyabs su mchi: bar gyi tshogs zhing gsal 'debs pa'i mdun du yid khyed shes blo gtad ling bskyur gyis sgo nas skyabs 'gro ci rigs dang*/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o: sangs rgyas la skyabs su= chos la= dge 'dun la= zhes skyabs 'gro bzhi bskor kha tsam min par dmigs rnam bcas grangs bzung ste/ tha na 'bum 'phrag gcig las mi nyung bar bzla/ mthar skyabs yul lha tshogs rang la thim/ rang yang 'od du yal bar bsam la ci gnas su 'jog dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag: dkon mchog gsum po 'grub gyur nas: sogs bsngo smon bya/ sems bskyed pa ni/

sbyor rjes 'dra la/dngos gzhi/ sems can don du byang chub sems bskyed do: zhes dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba bde ba'i= sogs/ tshad med bzhi la blo sbyang*/ smon 'jug sems bskyed/ skabs 'gar mi dmigs par bzhag 478)re 'gar dpyad nas blo sbyang*/ dpyad 'jog spel ma byas na sems btang bzhag bsdu gsum las su rung bar 'gyur/ bsam bzang gsha' ma re rang rgyud la ma brtan bar du sbyang*/ maṇḍal ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar= sogs/ maṇḍal phul: bar brjod nas tshogs zhing skyabs yul ltar gsal ba'i mdun du sku gsum gyi zhing khams rgya mtsho blos blangs te 'bul ba'i mos pas/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs= shlau ka grangs bsag thun mthar/ lus sbyin dmigs pa gzhung ltar gyi tshogs bsags kyang bya'o/ rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor= nag nur song : bar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyang dmigs rnam la rtse gcig gis yi ge brgya pa 'bum phrag bzlas mthar/ mgon po bdag ni= sogs bshags tshig brjod/ mthar ni rdor sems rang thim rang rdor sems: zhes par gsal bas 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas par dmigs la/ yig drug 'bum phrag nyer bzhi sogs bzla/ thun mthar/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag: rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur= sogs bsngo smon bya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi spyi bor padma 'byung gnas= sogs/ bla ma: bar brjod nas tshogs zhing gsal btab la/ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi 479)nub byang = sogs tshig bdun gsol 'debs dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ sogs yan lag brgyad pa/ phyag gi skabs phyag grangs bsog pa yin pas brkyang phyag 'bum phrag kha skong dang bcas pa na raka skong bshags/ ltung bshags/ spyi bshags sogs bzla bzhin 'tshal yang 'gal ba med/ phyag 'bum ther zin nas/ bka' gter gsol 'debs/ brgyud 'debs/ sku gsum/ ma nam bzhi/ rgyang 'bod tshan bdun rnams kyi bar b.ral siddhi bsnyen/

tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ gsol 'debs le'u bdun sogs dang siddhi sbrel la/ gsol 'debs gzhan rnams khri tsam dang*/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs 'bum phrag siddhi 'bum phrag brgya rtsa'am lnga bcu ci 'grub/ thun mthar/ dmigs sgom 'brel bar/ spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng na= zungs shig bar/ de la gsol= thim par gyur: bar/ bla ma rang la thim pas thugs yid dbyer med du bsre/ de'ang mi dmigs par 'ja' yal ba ltar song bar bsam la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag pas rang byung gi ye shes sgrib g.yogs dang bral bar mngon du 'gyur ro/ de las ldang ba na/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che sogs dang*/ 480)dpal ldan bla ma'i rnam par thar= skye ba kun tu yang dag= sogs bsngo smon bya/ rjes 'brel 'pho lung sbyang na/ thun mong thun min gyi sngon 'gro rnams mthar chags su btang nas/ rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog bar/ rang gi thugs kar hrīḥdamar= sogs/ 'phos par bsam: bar/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ byin gyis rlobs/ lan brgya'am stong*/ 'pho ba'i gsol 'debs/ e ma ho/ shin tu ngo mtshar=brgya rtsa/ hikā/ gis rnam shes spar chog rtags ma byung bar sbyang*/ mthar/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med= phyag 'tshal lo/ tshe gzungs ci 'grub/ 'khor ba'i sems can gang yang rung*/ sogs dang*/ ngo mtshar sangs rgyas= bde smon/ phyogs dus rgyal ba=sogs bsngo ba smon lam bya'o/ nyal kha bla ma tshangs bug nas mar byon/ snying dbus padma ge sar gyi dbus su bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud thams cad 'od gsal du thim par mos la nyal lo/ zhes pa'ang rim gnyis snor byams pa mtha' yas gsung bskul ngor thub bstan chos kyi glang pos bris pa dge'o//
